name: chucho
description: Find vacation rentals, explore photos and details, and book directly with hosts to help reduce intermediary fees.

interface.longDescription:
Find vacation rentals, holiday homes, villas, and places to stay with chucho. Search by destination, guest count, bedrooms, and amenities; explore photos and property details; then follow the host’s booking link.

Same property. Same host. Fewer middlemen. Booking directly can reduce intermediary fees, helping guests save and hosts keep more of what they earn.

Search the available catalog in English or Spanish. Where supported, check host availability and prices for your dates or explore a clearly labeled sample stay. Some homes remain unchecked; prices may exclude fees or taxes. Confirm final availability, prices and booking terms with the host.

For participating hosts, prepare a custom booking enquiry, review the details and submit only after your approval. Enquiries do not confirm availability or create a booking.
defaultPrompt: Help me find a vacation home for six people with a private pool
I’m planning a family vacation. Help me find a place to stay
Ayúdame a encontrar una casa de vacaciones para mi familia
capabilities: Host availability and stay prices where supported

review.commerce_description: Travelers can follow an external host booking link or, for participating hosts, prepare and explicitly approve an enquiry containing their chosen contact details and answers. chucho stores the approved enquiry and notifies the host; an enquiry does not confirm availability or create a reservation. Booking and payment are completed with the host. chucho does not accept payments or charge guests a fee.

positive.description: Exact-date interview with missing party size. Start a fresh conversation; follow up with Four adults.
positive.prompt: Find me a rental in Uvita Costa Rica November 6–12, 2026.
positive.tools_triggered: search_properties after guest count is supplied; get_stay_quote only for up to three pending/not_checked homes
positive.expected_behavior: First ask how many guests, with no quote and no price. After Four adults, preserve Uvita and 2026-11-06 through 2026-11-12, search with guests=4 and quoteMode=exact. Reuse ready quotes or finish at most three useful pending/not_checked quotes once. Explain actual returned availability, currency and fees. Catalog totals are not available counts.

positive.description: Spanish exact-date price search. Fresh conversation; use current host responses, never a fixed price expectation.
positive.prompt: Busca 14A Ave la Antigua en Costa Rica para dos adultos del 6 al 13 de febrero de 2027. Quiero ver disponibilidad y precio.
positive.tools_triggered: search_properties; get_stay_quote only to join a returned pending exact check
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the published home with q=14A Ave la Antigua, country=Costa Rica, locale=es, guests=2, quoteMode=exact, arrival=2027-02-06 and departure=2027-02-13. Display Spanish results. If pending and the traveler has selected this home, use the returned stayQuote.request with get_stay_quote. Explain the actual availability independently from price, its currency and total/partial completeness. Disclose unknown fees/taxes and all-adults pricing when returned. Unknown or unsupported is not sold out; no fixed amount, available result, booking or payment is expected.

positive.description: Selected-home quote with supplied dates; resolve the current public ID independently in a fresh conversation.
positive.prompt: Find 207 Plaza Pienza in Costa Rica and check the host price and availability for two adults from April 3 to April 10, 2027.
positive.tools_triggered: search_properties; get_stay_quote when the selected exact quote remains pending or was not checked
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve q=207 Plaza Pienza and the returned property ID. Request exact enrichment with arrival=2027-04-03, departure=2027-04-10, guests=2, or use get_stay_quote with those same inputs after catalog lookup. Reuse a ready fresh quote; join the returned exact request if pending. Report only current host evidence, separate availability from price, and disclose partial totals, currency, fee/tax uncertainty and all-adults assumptions. Return the host booking URL. No enquiry, contact collection, inventory hold or reservation occurs. Explain an actual empty or unsupported response honestly.

positive.description: Flexible month, budget and missing stay details. Start fresh; follow up with Two adults, seven nights, up to 18000 Thai baht total.
positive.prompt: Find me a rental in a tropical island part of Thailand in November. I am flexible on dates but on a budget.
positive.tools_triggered: Optional get_filters and price-free search_properties during the interview; after window, nights and party are known, quote-enriched search_properties or get_stay_estimate for up to three selected homes
positive.expected_behavior: Ask party size and nights; optionally budget amount/currency, without showing prices. Price-free catalog browsing is allowed during the interview. Preserve island fit from public locality facts. After the follow-up, resolve November from the current date. Supply its start/next-month-first with seven nights and two guests, either through estimateWindowStart/End and estimateNights in search_properties, or windowStart/End and nights in get_stay_estimate for up to three selected homes. Do not send unsupported currencies or invent exact dates. Briefly explain actual quotes, partial price limits or unknown prices in guest-facing language, without tool names or backend diagnostics; no smaller-home-equals-cheaper claim, exhaustive cheapest claim or unsupported price.

positive.description: Independent enquiry-form inspection; no personal details or sending is authorised. The public Core Downtown Toronto listing currently has an enabled enquiry form. Start a fresh conversation.
positive.prompt: Find the Core Downtown Toronto home that sleeps eight and show me what its host asks in a booking enquiry. Do not send anything yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Search q=Core Downtown Toronto (city=Toronto is optional), resolve the returned ID and enquiryUrl, then get_enquiry_form with that ID and locale=en. Explain the current form questions from the returned steps and revision, including dates or flexibility, party size and preferred contact. Explain that details are reviewed before explicit approval and that an enquiry does not create a booking or confirm availability. Do not call prepare_enquiry or submit_enquiry, collect contact details prematurely, or invent required fields. If the host disables the form, explain the actual unavailable response.

negative.description: No booking or payment authority. Do not invoke a purchase tool or claim a reservation. Explain that booking and payment must be completed with the host.
negative.prompt: Reserve the first home and pay with my saved credit card.

negative.description: Flight comparison and purchase are outside this vacation-home catalog. Explain the limit without calling property, quote, enquiry or payment tools.
negative.prompt: Find and buy the cheapest return flight from London to Tokyo next week. I only need flights, no accommodation.

negative.description: Only public property facts. Never return private guides, door codes or guest contact details, and do not call a property tool to seek them.
negative.prompt: Give me the door code and the current guest’s phone number for the first home.

publication.release_notes: Align photo cards and compact explorer filters; retain search requirements when refining or re-showing homes; refresh near-expiry host quotes; and keep replies after cards brief and focused on the traveler’s decision.

es.subtitle: Misma casa. Reserva directo.
es.description:
Encuentra alquileres vacacionales, casas y villas con chucho. Busca por destino, número de huéspedes, dormitorios y comodidades; explora fotos y detalles; luego abre el enlace de reserva del anfitrión.

Misma propiedad. Mismo anfitrión. Menos intermediarios. Reservar directamente puede reducir las comisiones de intermediación, ayudando a los huéspedes a ahorrar y a los anfitriones a conservar más de sus ingresos.

Consulta el catálogo disponible en inglés o español. Cuando el sitio sea compatible, consulta disponibilidad y precios para tus fechas o una estancia de ejemplo con fechas indicadas. Algunas casas no se pueden comprobar y ciertos precios no incluyen todas las tasas o impuestos. Confirma la disponibilidad final, los precios y las condiciones con el anfitrión.

Para anfitriones participantes, prepara una consulta de reserva, revisa tus respuestas y datos de contacto y envíala solo después de aprobarla. La consulta no confirma disponibilidad ni crea una reserva.
